verdict.rationale: Stripe has automation features (Billing automation, revenue recovery, Kyber-style no-code flows via Apps, webhooks), so this axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence shows versioning, diffing/reviewing, or rolling back automation definitions. Adjacent items don't deliver the story: API version pinning covers the API, not user automations; sandboxes are for testing; MCP human confirmation is per-action approval of agent writes.
